topic: Example reference for instruments with agentive subjects
claim: “Instruments normally occur in clauses where the subject (in the case of active clauses) has an agent role, as in [ia–d].”
evidence_summary: [12ia–d] (p. 673) are the means examples: She travels to work by bus, Sometimes you have to translate a noun in one language by a verb in another, He had gained access to the board by highly dubious means, They communicate by means of sign language. The instruments are [12iia–e], beginning She opened my door with the master-key. The next sentence (p. 674) turns to “the instrumental in [iie]”.
finding: Change [ia–d] to [iia–d]. The following paragraph gives the parallel point for means, “as in [12ie]”.
inference: Does the cited example contain instruments?

evidence.passage: §2.2, p. 674. “has an agent role, as in [ia–d]”.
